question: Does the 0.01->0.05 mm fixed-anchor tolerance hurry the same 3-sweep collection, and does the collected data still fit to the same anchors?

time.note: arm A's third sweep covers 43.443 mm more drive travel than arm B's, worth ~1.86 s at feed 1400 mm/min

sweep2.note: NOT matched: arm A traversed +43.4..-0.1 then -47.1..-0.1, arm B traversed -47.1..-0.1 twice

fits.note: both fits are far from the true HP3 anchors; k=3 is not identifiable (E10)

conclusion: First two sweeps are matched to the same tolerance as E07 (setpoints <=0.006 mm, lengths <=0.094 mm) and the ~24% time saving reproduces. The third sweep is not matched (90.5 mm), so the anchor-quality comparison is not usable, and at k=3 neither arm is identifiable. E11 therefore supports the time saving only, and weakly.
